in_arabic.name: زينب
in_arabic.meaning: زينب تعني الزهراء الجميلة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زينب مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'زين' و'ب'، ويعني الاسم في اللغة العربية الزهراء الجميلة، وقد ورد ذكر اسم زينب في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأحزاب، الآية ٣٦، حيث ذكرت السيدة زينب بنت جحش، وهي إحدى زوجات النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ويعتبر اسم زينب من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وروحانية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: زینب
in_urdu.meaning: زینب کا مطلب خوبصورت زہرا ہے اردو میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: زینب نام عربی زبان کے جڑ 'زین' اور 'ب' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت زہرا، یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم کردار رکھتا ہے کیونکہ زینب بنت جحش رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی ازواج مطہرات تھیں، اور قرآن کریم میں ان کا ذکر سورة الأحزاب میں کیا گیا ہے، اردو زبان میں یہ نام اپنی خوبصورت معانی اور روحانی اہمیت کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے

in_english.name: Zaynaab
in_english.meaning: Zaynaab means beautiful flower or blooming beauty in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaynaab is derived from the Arabic roots 'Zayn' and 'B', which signify beauty and bloom, respectively, it is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Ahzab, verse 36, referring to Zaynab bint Jahsh, one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad, the name carries connotations of beauty, elegance, and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a person with a beautiful character and soul

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaynab is of Arabic origin and is derived from the root word "zayn," meaning "beauty." This name has been cherished throughout Islamic history due to its association with several significant figures, including the Prophet Muhammad's granddaughter and the wife of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib. The name Zaynab became a symbol of beauty, grace, and resilience among the Islamic community and continues to be popular in the Middle East and around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Zaynab holds profound spiritual significance as a reminder of the inherent beauty and worth of every human being in the eyes of God. The life and story of Prophet Muhammad's granddaughter, Zaynab bint Ali, serve as an inspiration for many as a model of faith, patience, and perseverance during times of suffering and hardship. The name Zaynab is also a reminder of the importance of inner beauty and character over superficial external appearance. It is believed that those named Zaynab are blessed with grace, strength, and the ability to inspire others through their actions and words.
